notes: Dev ABox revision carried by subproperty: largest_city_of ⊑ located_in, so the related-near question asks which country the new largest city is in (Italy, then Nigeria). From there located_in transitivity reaches the continent (derived), inheritance carries a country-wide fact into a practical task (which language a street sign must use), and binding reaches Nigeria by a description it holds separately (the country whose capital is Abuja). Related far follows the edit to Milan and looks up a stored fact about it (composition): Nigeria's largest city is a coastal city before (Lagos, stated as a port city in the same Wikipedia paragraph that makes it the largest city) and not after (Milan is inland). A stored "Nigeria's largest city is a port" kept by description would make Milan a coastal city, which contradicts a firm fact about Milan, so the query is determinate. The earlier related-far question (which country La Scala is in) was dropped: "La Scala is in Italy" is stored on its own, so a model could keep La Scala in Italy and drop "La Scala is in Milan" (background beliefs). The earlier binding through "Africa's most populous country" was dropped too: "Lagos, the largest city in / the commercial capital of Africa's most populous country" is a recurring news phrase (about 40 exact hits across its forms), so the answer could not be placed clearly as worked out or as stored. Milan is the capital of Lombardy, so "capital of Lombardy" plus "Lombardy is in Italy" is a stored route back to Italy; it does not make Milan's country or continent indeterminate, because the route asserts that Milan itself is in Italy, which contradicts the forced "Milan is in Nigeria" (largest_city_of ⊑ located_in), so after the edit it is "Milan is in Lombardy" that gives way. As in the template, a model that keeps Milan in Italy has a largest city outside its country, which is no world. São Paulo and Brazil were avoided because a main RBox record uses "São Paulo is the largest city of Brazil" as an instance. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama) except those marked approximate.
